question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a brown ball, Bob has a grey ball, Claire has a red ball, Dave has a gold ball, Eve has a teal ball, Fred has a black ball, and Gertrude has a orange ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Bob swap balls. Then, Bob and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Finally, Claire and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) brown ball
(B) grey ball
(C) red ball
(D) gold ball
(E) teal ball
(F) black ball
(G) orange ball
solution:
Each row lists the ball colors held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: brown | grey | red | gold | teal | black | orange
After Fred–Alice: black | grey | red | gold | teal | brown | orange
After Dave–Gertrude: black | grey | red | orange | teal | brown | gold
After Gertrude–Bob: black | gold | red | orange | teal | brown | grey
After Bob–Alice: gold | black | red | orange | teal | brown | grey
After Dave–Alice: orange | black | red | gold | teal | brown | grey
After Fred–Dave: orange | black | red | brown | teal | gold | grey
After Claire–Dave: orange | black | brown | red | teal | gold | grey
Bob has the black ball, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
